name: Knott's Coasters Diner Classic Double Cheeseburger with French Fries
whyItWorks: Two griddled beef patties with melted American cheese on a soft sesame seed bun. When ordered without raw onions, pickles, or special sauce, it digests easily in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Double Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold special sauce, lettuce, tomato, onions, and pickles).
